Thanks for forwarding. I did the 45-min screen with Rami and Ben this afternoon (we stuck to the goals). Quick notes:

- Likes: Deep on attention to KV-cache eviction policies, had solid examples of batching improvements and measured gains; good pragmatic approach to quantization tradeoffs. Asked good follow-ups about model-staging and rollouts.
- Concerns: Needs clearer long-term sponsorship plan (candidate was candid about EAD expiry), mentioned smaller team sizes historically — might need time ramping into ownership of large infra.
- Communication: Clear and concise, good at diagramming live.

Score (technical fit): 7/10
Recommendation: Move to panel interview (60m) — include one infra-focused senior eng and PM to cover product implications. Ask candidate for compensation expectations and notice period before scheduling the panel.
